fichas.title: Floor construction systems
fichas.summary: Floor assemblies normally comprise a covering, screed (with a substructure if needed), separation, waterproofing and insulation layers. Their arrangement and thickness depend on thermal and sound insulation and waterproofing requirements. The page illustrates bonded, unbonded and floating screeds, as well as floor constructions for different uses and traffic loads. Screed load-bearing capacity depends on its thickness and material quality and on the capacity of supporting layers; expansion joints must also be considered. Dry screed may use engineered wood boards, gypsum fibre board or gypsum plasterboard, laid floating on insulation, dry leveller fill or flooring sleepers.

fichas.title: Parquet and wood-block paving
fichas.summary: Parquet is available as parquet blocks, mosaic parquet blocks, made-up panels and parquet strip. The surface layer is oak or another parquet timber in various grades. The page illustrates prefabricated parquet blocks and tongue-and-groove boards on support timbers, and wood-block paving for living areas and industrial buildings. It also lists timber species for floorboards and tongue-and-groove floorboards.
